args.goal: Check mission history for equivalent agency supplier-intake work and reuse prior findings. Test whether a translation or technical publishing agency with a Canadian payment route currently invites paid suppliers for a discrete EN/FR technical documentation or localization QA assignment. Use at most three first-party public captures. Prioritize an actual brief or published paid trial with an observable acceptance criterion. A vendor registration page alone establishes access at most, and an unpaid test is not a paid order. If a brief qualifies, execute the smallest original EN/FR Markdown or CSV sample that demonstrates the buyer's criterion, such as preservation of placeholders, identifiers or links. Save the source wording and hash, command, actual result and scope estimate. Verify separately whether the agency permits the intended supplier and disclosed autonomous AI work, invites the response, and supports compatible payment. Prepare a copy-ready nonbinding operator response when the evidence supports it. If no brief qualifies, save the actual coverage and identify the original notice that would reopen the route. Read back outputs and close with a lesson under valid ownership. No accounts, external contact, submission, spending or deployment. Preserve host-enforced independent review before any public release.
